subject: Evaluation scope & acceptance playbook for BlueOak pilot
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ana Lopez <ana@blueoakhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Hi Ana —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a compact evaluation playbook that lays out: scope, success criteria, exit gates, and a recommended test matrix aligned to your pilot timeline. Attached is a working MAP (BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC2 evidence checklist we usually ship to procurement.

Key asks from us to make the window successful:
- Confirm the three business scenarios we will prioritize (listed in the MAP).
- Provide a single technical contact for SOC2 evidence requests (we referenced Michael below).
- Identify an initial set of 20 canonical prompts for quality signal monitoring.

High-level acceptance signal we propose (example):
- Latency: P95 < 800ms for 1k concurrent users in the pilot config.
- Accuracy: intent match >= 92% on the core triage set.
- Safety: zero critical policy violations in the first 5000 generations.

If this looks good, I'd like to lock the MAP and schedule a 30-min kick-off this week to align owners.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (pdf, 75KB)
From: Ana Lopez <ana@blueoakhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.t@blueoakhealth.com>, BlueOak Legal <legal@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Alex —

Thanks, this is helpful and compact. Quick answers:
- The three scenarios look right (patient intake triage, billing-code suggestion, provider note summarization).
- Michael will be the SOC2/technical point — looping him in.
- We can get you 25 canonical prompts by EOD Thursday.

Two asks from our side before locking:
1) Can we confirm a rollback gate (what behavior triggers stopping the pilot)?
2) We need a short remediation SLA for safety/regression issues — e.g., 4-hour ack, 48-hour remediation plan.

Would prefer a kickoff Thurs 09/16 at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Best,
Ana Lopez
Head of Patient Experience
BlueOak Health
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Laura / Marissa —

FYI: BlueOak signed off on the scenarios and asked for a rollback gate + remediation SLA. Can you both review the MAP attachment and propose an explicit rollback definition and remediation SLA we can commit to? Keep in mind we should not overpromise on remediation for model issues that require engineering (but can commit to detection/triage SLAs).

Suggested rollback language to consider: "If production error rate for critical flows exceeds 3% over a 4-hour rolling window OR if any verified safety-critical generation occurs, Redwood and BlueOak agree to pause the pilot and revert to prior model variant until a remediation plan is in place."

Can you draft this and add to the MAP by EOD tomorrow? I will then send back to Ana with the kickoff invite.

— Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Alex / Laura —

Quick draft edits added to the MAP: see attached version BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated). Main points I added:
- Exit gates: production pause triggers (3% critical-flow error over 4h OR confirmed safety violation).
- Acceptance tests: daily automated smoke (latency/throughput), weekly sample-quality audit on 200 examples, and a final load test at 75% projected peak.
- Remediation SLA: 4-hour incident acknowledgement, 48-hour mitigation plan for critical production regressions; 10 business day remediation window for lower-priority model tuning requests (with weekly status updates).

I also added a short test matrix mapping prompts to expected outputs and owner (BlueOak product / BlueOak clinical SME / Redwood QA).

If this aligns I can push the MAP to the shared Drive and pre-populate the kickoff agenda.

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Looping in security notes for the kickoff:
- We should include explicit logging scope in the MAP (request/response hashes, token counts, sampling rate) and a default data-retention of 30 days unless BlueOak requests otherwise.
- For SOC2 evidence requests, attach the mini-checklist (SOC2-evidence-request.pdf) and ask BlueOak to share their standard POA&M timeline if they expect any deviations.
- Confirm whether PII redaction is required for the pilot; if yes we need to configure the ingestion pipeline and that will add 2–3 business days to setup.

I'll be on the kickoff to walk through evidence and retention details.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ana Lopez <ana@blueoakhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.t@blueoakhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, BlueOak Legal <legal@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation scope & acceptance playbook — BlueOak

Ana —

Thanks for the quick turn. We updated the MAP with the rollback language, acceptance tests, remediation SLA, and security checklist. I uploaded the updated workbook to the shared Drive and attached the SOC2 mini-checklist for your legal/tech team. Kickoff scheduled for Thurs 09/16 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Summary of agreed evaluation exit/acceptance points:
- Go / no-go decision: after 3 weeks of pilot data and one final load test.
- Exit gate (pause): >3% critical-flow errors over 4h OR any confirmed safety-critical generation.
- Acceptance: P95 latency < 800ms; intent match >= 92%; no critical safety events in the final audit.
- Remediation: 4-hour ack / 48-hour mitigation plan for critical items.
- Security: default 30-day retention, request/response hashing enabled; PII redaction queued if requested (2–3 day setup).

Next steps (owners):
- BlueOak: supply 25 canonical prompts (Ana / Michael) by EOD Thurs.
- Redwood QA: seed test matrix and run initial smoke tests (Marissa).
- Security: confirm evidence handoff at kickoff (Rishi).

Attachments: BlueOak_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

See you on Thursday —
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
